modelsReadme:
Live2D Mate - Models Folder
==========================

Drop the WHOLE folder of a downloaded Live2D model in here, for example:

  models/
    Hiyori/
      Hiyori.model3.json      <- Cubism 3/4/5 entry file
      Hiyori.moc3
      Hiyori.2048/...
      motions/...

Rules:
  * Only Cubism 3/4/5 models (*.model3.json) are supported
  * Legacy packages whose entry file is just model.json or index.json also work,
    as long as their contents are Cubism 3/4/5
  * Cubism 2.1 models (*.model.json) cannot be read and are skipped
  * Only 3 folder levels deep are scanned, anything deeper is ignored
  * The model name comes from the folder holding the entry file

Once the files are in place, right-click the tray icon, choose "Settings...",
then the "Models" tab and press "Rescan"; the new model shows up in the list.
